name: faangin-backend
description: Faangin Supabase accounts, Postgres billing, licensing and Edge Pro gateway

scripts.build: npm --prefix supabase run typecheck && npm --prefix gateway run build && npm run check:edge
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix supabase run typecheck && npm --prefix gateway run typecheck && npm run check:edge
scripts.test: npm run check:secrets && npm run test:tooling && npm --prefix supabase test && npm --prefix gateway test && npm run test:client && npm run test:edge && npm run test:sql && npm run smoke:gateway
scripts.test:sql: npm --prefix supabase run test:sql && npm --prefix gateway run test:sql
